reviews.title: When they say quiet they mean quiet.
reviews.comment: Exceptional value for the price. Clean style without flashy lights. No compatibility issues. Installed in seconds. Truly silent. Nearly silent and no vibrational hum, either.  Seems very well constructed. Plenty of cable length.
reviews.author: Kris

reviews.title: Great fan!
reviews.comment: Recently purchased this fan as my original fan started clicking and becoming noisy. This fan is incredibly quiet and was easy to install! It works well with keeping the pc cool, fit perfectly, and was a great price!
reviews.author: Asileven

reviews.title: Truly quiet, unclear how much air they move..
reviews.comment: I dont have a way to test, but i feel like these should be moving more air. Sorry for the vibes based review, but unless im just not getting static pressure and the CFM on these is lower than i realized, I feel that these are just kinda poor fans when compared with really not much louder options. If you just need a little air moved though, they live up to the name. You wont notice unless your ear is up right next to the thing.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Very quiet.  Low flow/ low pressure.
reviews.comment: Very quiet low flow/ low pressure. I used these in a home made air filter made from four MERV 14 filter elements taped together to form a box, with solid cardboard at the bottom and cardboard with 8 of these attached at the top. It worked well, produced about 1\15th the noise of my HEPA filter, with over double the air flow.  The effect was actually better at removing Pollen, pet hair\dander. Later I added a heavy-duty 8 inch GAC duct filter to remove smells and chemicals from the air and had to upgrade to a large turbine fan to pull the air through the inch thick layer of carbon granules.  The carbon filter is a huge upgrade to my air quality, removing all smellsand chemicals, except it smells a little moldy when the air is very damp.
reviews.author: Neug

reviews.title: False product info
reviews.comment: Either you need to fix your product info or you'll have a lot more negative reviews. Was looking for a 4-pin, not another 3-pin to replace a loud 3-pin pc case fan....now just a slightly quieter pc case fan.
